List every file BLS publishes for a source

Source: R/bls-registry.R
blsFiles.Rd

List every file BLS publishes for a source

Usage

blsFiles(source, email, data_only = TRUE)

Arguments

source

A registry name (see blsSources) or a bare two-letter BLS prefix (e.g. "wp").

email

Contact email, required by BLS in the user agent.

data_only

Logical, default TRUE: return only .data.* files, not lookup tables.

Value

A tibble: stem (pass to getBLSFiles(..., file = )), mb, modified (remote mtime), file (full BLS name).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  blsFiles("ppi", "your.email@example.com")
} # }
